title: Topic brief synthesis result
description: What the model must return. Validated in code before anything is rendered: the citation rule is enforced here and again in render.py, never by asking the model nicely. item_ids are integers on purpose, so a model that quotes an id as a string fails validation upstream instead of being silently dropped by the renderer.

buckets.description: Sections in the order the profile listed them. Omit a bucket entirely rather than padding it.

name.description: Must match one of the bucket names given in the prompt, verbatim.

watch_list.description: On-topic but ambiguous items, one line each, for a human to judge.

merged.description: Groups of input item numbers judged to be the same story, so the operator can see what was collapsed.

text.description: One claim, stated plainly. Dollar amounts, names, sponsors and deadlines quoted verbatim from the source.

item_ids.description: The input item numbers this claim rests on. An entry with none is dropped before rendering.
